simple.meaning: רְבָבָה (rᵉbâbâh) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “abundance (in number), i.e. (specifically) a myriad (whether definite or indefinite).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 24:60. The surrounding context includes birth, family, firstborn, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רְבָבָה (H7233) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.short: abundance (in number), i.e. (specifically) a myriad (whether definite or indefinite)
definitions.full: H7233. rebabah רְבָבָה noun feminine multitude, myriad, ten thousand (Kö ii.1.221 ); — absolute ׳ר Gen 24:60 +; suffix רִבְבָתוֺ Kt 1Sam 18:7 2 t. (Qr רִבְבֹתָיו ); plural absolute רְבָבוֺת 18:8 construct ִרבְבוֺת Micah 6:7 +, ִרבֲבוֺת Deut 33:17 ; suffixsee above Qr; — myriad 10, 000: of great number of person, indefinite Gen 24:60 (J; רְבָבָה אַלְפֵי thousands of myriads ), Deut 33:2 (poem; קֹרֶשׁ מֵרִבְבוֺת , but see קֹרֶשׁ , near the end). Psa 3:7 ; ct 5:10 ; תִשׂ אַלְפֵי ׳ִרבְבוֺת Num 10:36 , compare Deut 33:17 (poem); — רְבָבָה Ezek 16:7 read ᵐ5 רְבִי Co Berthol Krae; — more precisely(100, 1000), 10, 000, Judg 20:10 ; opposed to 2, Deut 32:30 (poem), opposed to 100, Lev 26:8 (H), opposed to 1000, 1Sam 18:7-8 , 21:12 ; 29:5 ; Psa 91:7 ; so of things, Micah 6:7 .
